newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open up 0.60 to 0.90 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open up 0.60 to 0.90 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open 0.60 to 0.90 cent firmer Tuesday as LME rose after stocks increased only by a small amount whereas many traders had expected a sharper hike.
LME stocks rose 200 tonnes Tuesday to 131,475 tonnes.
March last traded on ACCESS at 107.50 cents a lb, up 1.15 cents.
The LME cash to three months spread remained strong at $185.
COMEX copper stocks fell 2,430 short tons Monday to 27,578 short tons.
December's U.S. consumer prices and retail sales figures, forecast to rise 0.3 percent and 0.5 percent, respectively, are due at 0830 EST.
December real earnings data are due at 1000.
